note: not a forecast accuracy or model-promotion result

reason: fold 0 has no previous validation-selected exposure

metrics.definition: 100 * sum of aligned additive strategy-minus-B&H net PnL; selected constant only

timing_increment.reason: a constant exposure has no temporal timing path; no timing alpha is claimed

cscv_pbo.definition: PBO = fraction of CSCV IS winners with OOS rank below the median
cscv_pbo.note: CSCV/PBO is report-only over twelve test subperiods and never feeds validation selection

deflated_sharpe.formula: Phi((SR_hat-SR_star)*sqrt(T-1)/sqrt(1-g3*SR_hat+((g4-1)/4)*SR_hat^2)); SR_star uses Euler-weighted expected max over N trials
deflated_sharpe.note: DSR is a diagnostic over fixed grid plus the adaptive selector; it is not used to select exposure

selected_alpha_sign_test.reason: selected constant alpha fold totals has 11 non-zero folds; need at least 12

stress.note: cost paths recompute the same selected decisions; regime thresholds use train+validation only

metrics.interpretation: Even if every baseline criterion passes, this is a low-frequency constant-exposure diagnostic and cannot promote a forecast/model candidate.

thresholds.selected_vs_previous: median and mean AlphaEx strictly higher; positive-fold count no lower on folds 1..11
